query:
INSERT INTO media_launches (
            id,
            media_id,
            agent_id,
            name,
            launch_type,
            program,
            arguments,
            working_directory,
            is_default,
            enabled
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        RETURNING
            id,
            media_id,
            agent_id,
            name,
            launch_type,
            program,
            arguments,
            working_directory,
            is_default AS "is_default: bool",
            enabled AS "enabled: bool"
